comments.comment:
Analysis from Gemini

This failure is a known flaky test race condition in sanity.sh:test_271f caused by an asynchronous background statahead thread from a previous test (test_270h).

Timeline & Evidence from sanity.test_271f.debug_log.onyx-155vm51.1787901338.log

  1. Leftover Background Statahead: A background statahead thread (ll_sa.0) started in test 270h for directory d270h.sanity was still running asynchronously in the background when test_271f started.
  1. The RPC Breakdown during test_271f: At 1787901338.01, test_271f cleared the MDC statistics (lctl set_param -n mdc.*.stats=clear) and ran cat /etc/hosts >> $dom.
    • test_271f generated 5 RPCs:
      • 4 ×× ldlm_ibits_enqueue (opc 101)
      • 1 ×× mds_close (opc 35)
    • The background statahead thread concurrently sent a 6th RPC:
      • At 1787901338.035251: PID 812518 (ll_sa.0) sent an MDS_BATCH (opc 63) RPC to MDT0000 for d270h.sanity.
  1. The Race at get_mdc_stats: When test_271f queried get_mdc_stats $mdtidx 'req_wait|req_active|ost_read' at 1787901338.054:
    • req_waittime was sampled first: 5 completed replies.
    • req_active was sampled next: 6 initiated requests (the 5 from test_271f + the 1 in-flight MDS_BATCH from statahead).
    • test_271f evaluated (( ra == rw )) →→ 6 == 5 (False), and erroneously assumed the difference was an RPC resend:

text
 
sanity test_271f: @@@@@@ FAIL: 1 resend occured on append

  1. Statahead Thread Termination: Right after the test failed, the log confirms the statahead thread finished cleaning up:

text
 
1787901338.162014: statahead thread stopped: sai ff3085bdf6e79c00, parent d270h.sanity hit 0 miss 0

Conclusion

  • No actual resends occurred (rq_resend was 0 for all RPCs).
  • The failure was a transient interference where test_270h's background statahead thread leaked an RPC into test_271f's MDC stat measurement window.
